description.p: OpenHamShack ATV generates, transmits, receives and decodes 625-line PAL amateur television with sound: AM-VSB (System I style) and FM-ATV (IARU R1 V.2, CCIR 405 pre-emphasis, 6 MHz sound subcarrier) on the 23cm and 6cm bands, and analogue receive on 70cm.

It drives the ADALM-Pluto family (Pluto, Pluto+, Pluto nano, LibreSDR) through libiio, generates its own picture - a test card with the station's ident, colour bars, a webcam or a video file - and decodes received pictures in the program with a waveform monitor and a vectorscope. A simulated radio lets it run, and be tested, with no hardware and without transmitting anything.
